nodes.question: What are the potential health impacts of increased physical activity resulting from changes in transportation infrastructure?
nodes.answer: Increased physical activity from changes in transportation infrastructure can lead to improved health outcomes such as reduced risk of chronic diseases like obesity and cardiovascular issues.
